    vim.opt_local.softtabstop = 4
    vim.opt_local.shiftwidth = 4

children.text: -- This file is loaded INSTEAD of hyprland.conf when present (checked once
-- at compositor startup), so log out & back in after changing between them.
-- Reload manually any time with:  hyprctl reload
-- Your favorite programs, referenced by the keybinds below.
-- The main modifier key ("Windows" key). Used to build all Super combos.
-- Catch-all: any unknown/unplugged monitor uses its preferred mode,
-- Built-in laptop display: fixed 2880x1800 @ 120Hz, fractional scaling 1.5x.
gaps_out = 10, -- outer gaps around the screen edge (px)
-- Custom bezier curve: fast start, smooth ease-out finish.
-- Points are control points of a cubic bezier: {x, y} pairs.
-- speed is in "deciseconds per animation" style units (higher = slower),
-- bezier selects which curve to use ("default" = built-in curve).
hl.animation({ leaf = "windows", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- windows opening/moving
hl.animation({ leaf = "windowsOut", enabled = true, speed = 4, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- windows closing
hl.animation({ leaf = "border", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "default" }) -- border color changes
hl.animation({ leaf = "fade", enabled = true, speed = 4, bezier = "default" }) -- opacity fades
hl.animation({ leaf = "workspaces", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- workspace switches
no_hardware_cursors = true, -- render cursors in software (fixes glitches on some GPUs)
disable_hyprland_logo = false, -- keep the Hyprland logo on startup
disable_splash_rendering = false, -- keep the splash text on startup
disable_logs = false, -- keep writing logs to disk
enable_stdout_logs = true, -- also mirror logs to stdout
kb_options = "caps:swapescape", -- swap Caps Lock and Escape
follow_mouse = 1, -- focus follows the mouse cursor
natural_scroll = true, -- invert scrolling direction on touchpad
-- Everything in this handler runs ONCE when Hyprland starts
-- (equivalent of exec-once; NOT re-run by hyprctl reload).
hl.exec_cmd("systemctl --user start hyprpolkitagent.service 2>/dev/null || true") -- polkit auth agent
-- Toggle real fullscreen with Super + F.
-- Move the focused window around the layout: Super + Shift + H/J/K/L.
-- Resize the focused window (repeats while held): Super + Ctrl + H/J/K/L.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + H", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = -50, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + J", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = 50, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + K", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = -50, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + L", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 50, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
-- Toggle floating on the active window.
-- Center the active window (useful when floating).
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + Q", hl.dsp.window.close()) -- close focused window
-- move the focused window there with Super + Shift + [num].
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + " .. i, hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = i }))
-- `locked`    = works even while the screen is locked (old bindl).
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessDown", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set 10%-"), { repeating = true, locked = true })
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessUp", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set 10%+"), { repeating = true, locked = true })
hl.bind("XF86AudioMute", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle"), { locked = true })
--   Print            -> select region, copy image to clipboard
--   Super + Print    -> select region, save timestamped file to ~/Pictures
--   Super + Shift+Print -> full screen, copy image to clipboard
-- Super + D -> show desktop (toggle special workspace named "desktop")
-- Super + Shift + A -> minimize current window
-- Super + Shift + B -> restore oldest minimized window
-- Tapping Super alone (on release) also opens the drawer.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SUPER_L", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("nwg-drawer -wm hyprland"), { release = true })

## Summary

The archive contains a more modular Hyprland setup split into separate Lua files. Your current setup is mostly consolidated in `hyprland.lua`.

### Features in the archive that differ from yours

| Area | Archived config | Your current config |
|---|---|---|
| Configuration structure | Separate modules for environment, monitors, input, bindings, appearance, and startup | Mostly one file |
| Modifier key | Caps Lock becomes a Hyper/`MOD3` modifier | Super is the main modifier; Caps swaps with Escape |
| Launcher tools | Walker app launcher, calculator, emoji picker, clipboard manager | `nwg-drawer` |
| File manager | Yazi inside Ghostty | Nautilus |
| Monitor scaling | `1.33` scale, preferred resolution, HDMI support | Laptop fixed at `2880x1800@120`, scale `1.5`; generic fallback |
| External monitor | Explicit `HDMI-A-1` configuration | No explicit HDMI configuration |
| Window spacing | No gaps: `gaps_in=0`, `gaps_out=0` | Inner gaps `5`, outer gaps `10` |
| Borders | 1px with green/cyan gradient active border | 2px, default border colors |
| Rounding | 10px with custom rounding power | 8px |
| Opacity/shadows/blur | Explicitly configured; shadows and blur disabled | Not explicitly configured |
| Animations | Detailed animations for windows, layers, fades, workspaces, zoom | Basic window, border, fade, and workspace animations |
| Dwindle behavior | `preserve_split=true` | Not configured |
| Master layout | Configured with new windows as master | Not configured |
| Scrolling layout | Fullscreen behavior configured | Not configured |
| Mouse controls | Super + mouse drag to move/resize windows | Not configured |
| Workspace scrolling | Super + mouse wheel switches workspaces | Not configured |
| Window switching | `Alt+Tab` cycles windows | Not configured |
| Workspace count | Workspaces 1-10, with `0` mapped to 10 | Workspaces 1-9 |
| Named workspaces | Toggle-and-reopen workflows for tmux, Nvim, music, Discord, etc. | Only special `desktop` workspace |
| Launcher submap | Super + I, then 1-4 launches ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Grok | No submap |
| Application bindings | Firefox, Chromium, qutebrowser, Obsidian, Typora, btop, nvtop, lazydocker, web apps | Chrome, VS Code, Nautilus, drawer |
| Window movement | Prevents moving windows out of named workspaces | No such guard |
| Resize controls | Super + `=`/`-` and shifted variants | H/J/K/L resize controls |
| Window rules | Rules for maximization, XWayland dragging, qBittorrent, tmux, Vulkan, and Zig windows | No window rules |
| Hyprland permissions | Explicit screencopy permissions for `grim` and XDG desktop portal | Not configured |
| Environment variables | Extensive Wayland, NVIDIA, Electron, GTK, Qt, Java, SDL, cursor, and NixOS settings | None in the active Hyprland config |
| Startup | `awww`, Elephant, GNOME theme settings, Bluetooth power-off, custom Waybar toggle | Hyprpaper, Waybar, dock script, polkit, network tray, Bluetooth tray |
| Input | Sensitivity `0`, touchpad natural scroll disabled, scroll factor `0.4` | Sensitivity `0.3`, touchpad natural scroll enabled, scroll factor `1.0` |
| Gestures | Three-finger horizontal swipe changes workspace | None |
| Device-specific settings | Special mouse sensitivity override | None |
| Lock screen | Clock, date, username, keyboard layout indicator, failure text, animations, gradient states | Minimal password prompt with screenshot background |

### Features your config has that the archive does not

Your current configuration includes:

- `nwg-drawer` as the launcher.
- Super-alone drawer binding.
- Custom minimize and restore scripts.
- Dedicated dock startup script.
- `hyprpaper` wallpaper daemon.
- Explicit 120 Hz laptop monitor mode.
- Screenshot bindings using `grim` and `slurp`.
- Software cursor rendering for GPU compatibility.
- Locked-screen media and volume controls.
- NetworkManager and Bluetooth tray applets.
- Super + D desktop special workspace.

## Recommendations

### Definitely implement

1. **Add window rules**

The archived rules are the most practically valuable addition. In particular:

- Suppress applications trying to maximize themselves.
- Fix troublesome XWayland drag behavior.
- Put development tools such as Vulkan/Zig windows on a dedicated workspace.
- Automatically fullscreen your tmux window.
- Move qBittorrent to a silent background workspace.

Your current config has no window rules at all. This is the clearest functional gap.

2. **Add mouse window movement and resizing**

Super + left-click drag to move and Super + right-click drag to resize is much faster than keyboard-only resizing for floating windows.

3. **Add `Alt+Tab` window cycling**

The archive’s `Alt+Tab` binding is a useful low-friction workflow improvement and does not conflict with your current bindings.

4. **Add three-finger workspace gestures**

The archive’s horizontal three-finger workspace switching is worth adopting if your touchpad supports it.

5. **Add explicit external-monitor handling**

Your current fallback may work, but the archived configuration explicitly handles `HDMI-A-1`. A preferred-mode rule with automatic scale is more flexible when docking or connecting a monitor.

6. **Add Hyprland screencopy permissions**

The archive explicitly permits `grim` and `xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland` to use screencopy. This can prevent screenshot or screen-sharing failures on newer Hyprland versions.

### Worth considering

- Configure `dwindle.preserve_split=true`.
- Add microphone mute to the multimedia keys.
- Add workspace `10` on key `0`.
- Add a richer lock screen with clock, date, user, and keyboard layout.
- Add the archive’s detailed animation configuration if you prefer more animated transitions.
- Split your large `hyprland.lua` into modules for maintainability.

### Do not copy blindly

Avoid copying the archive’s environment and startup configuration wholesale:

- Paths such as `/home/ec/...` will not work for you.
- The NVIDIA variables should only be used if your system actually uses NVIDIA.
- `bluetoothctl power off` disables Bluetooth at login.
- `GTK_THEME=Dracula` and `QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE=kvantum` impose a specific theme.
- `awww`, `walker`, `elephant`, and the custom Waybar scripts may not be installed.
- The archive’s Caps Lock modifier would conflict with your current Caps/Escape behavior.

The highest-value changes are window rules, mouse drag controls, `Alt+Tab`, screencopy permissions, and explicit external-monitor support.

------------------------

    mode = "preferred",
    position = "auto",

})

-- Built-in laptop display: fixed 2880x1800 @ 120Hz, fractional scaling 1.5x.

hl.animation({ leaf = "windows", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- windows opening/moving

-- ============================================================================
-- Hyprland configuration (Lua) — migrated from hyprland.conf
-- Requires Hyprland >= 0.55 (Lua config support).
-- This file is loaded INSTEAD of hyprland.conf when present (checked once
-- at compositor startup), so log out & back in after changing between them.
-- Reload manually any time with:  hyprctl reload
--
-- API reference: https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/
-- LSP stubs for autocompletion: /usr/share/hypr/stubs/
-- ============================================================================

-----------------------
---- MY PROGRAMS ------
-----------------------

-- Your favorite programs, referenced by the keybinds below.
local terminal = "ghostty"

-- The main modifier key ("Windows" key). Used to build all Super combos.
local mainMod = "SUPER"

------------------------
---- MONITORS ----------
------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Monitors/

-- Catch-all: any unknown/unplugged monitor uses its preferred mode,
-- auto-positioned, scale 1.
hl.monitor({
    output = "",
    mode = "preferred",
    position = "auto",
    scale = 1,
})

-- Built-in laptop display: fixed 2880x1800 @ 120Hz, fractional scaling 1.5x.
hl.monitor({
    output = "eDP-1",
    mode = "2880x1800@120",
    position = "auto",
    scale = 1.5,
})

---------------------------
---- LOOK AND FEEL --------
---------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Variables/
hl.config({
    general = {
        gaps_in = 5, -- inner gaps between windows (px)
        gaps_out = 10, -- outer gaps around the screen edge (px)
        border_size = 2, -- window border thickness (px)

        layout = "dwindle", -- tiling layout engine
    },

    decoration = {
        rounding = 8, -- window corner rounding radius (px)
    },

    animations = {
        enabled = true,
    },
})

-- Custom bezier curve: fast start, smooth ease-out finish.
-- Points are control points of a cubic bezier: {x, y} pairs.
hl.curve("easeOut", {
    type = "bezier",
    points = { { 0.16, 1 }, { 0.3, 1 } },
})

-- Per-element animation settings.
-- speed is in "deciseconds per animation" style units (higher = slower),
-- bezier selects which curve to use ("default" = built-in curve).
hl.animation({ leaf = "windows", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- windows opening/moving
hl.animation({ leaf = "windowsOut", enabled = true, speed = 4, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- windows closing
hl.animation({ leaf = "border", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "default" }) -- border color changes
hl.animation({ leaf = "fade", enabled = true, speed = 4, bezier = "default" }) -- opacity fades
hl.animation({ leaf = "workspaces", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- workspace switches

hl.config({
    cursor = {
        no_hardware_cursors = true, -- render cursors in software (fixes glitches on some GPUs)
    },

    misc = {
        disable_hyprland_logo = false, -- keep the Hyprland logo on startup
        disable_splash_rendering = false, -- keep the splash text on startup
    },

    debug = {
        disable_logs = false, -- keep writing logs to disk
        enable_stdout_logs = true, -- also mirror logs to stdout
    },
})

--------------------------
---- INPUT ---------------
--------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Variables/

hl.config({
    input = {
        kb_layout = "us", -- keyboard layout
        kb_options = "caps:swapescape", -- swap Caps Lock and Escape

        follow_mouse = 1, -- focus follows the mouse cursor
        scroll_factor = 1.0, -- wheel scroll speed multiplier
        sensitivity = 0.3, -- pointer sensitivity (-1.0 .. 1.0)
        natural_scroll = false,

        touchpad = {
            natural_scroll = true, -- invert scrolling direction on touchpad
            scroll_factor = 1.0,
        },
    },
})

--------------------------
---- AUTOSTART -----------
--------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Autostart/

-- Everything in this handler runs ONCE when Hyprland starts
-- (equivalent of exec-once; NOT re-run by hyprctl reload).
hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    hl.exec_cmd("hyprpaper") -- wallpaper daemon (see hyprpaper.conf)
    hl.exec_cmd("waybar") -- status bar
    hl.exec_cmd(os.getenv("HOME") .. "/.config/hypr/scripts/start-dock.sh") -- custom dock starter
    hl.exec_cmd("systemctl --user start hyprpolkitagent.service 2>/dev/null || true") -- polkit auth agent
    hl.exec_cmd("nm-applet --indicator") -- network manager tray icon
    hl.exec_cmd("blueman-applet") -- bluetooth tray icon
end)

-----------------------------
---- WINDOW MANAGEMENT ------
-----------------------------

-- Toggle real fullscreen with Super + F.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + F", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "fullscreen", action = "toggle" }))

-- Move the focused window around the layout: Super + Shift + H/J/K/L.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + H", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "l" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + J", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "d" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + K", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "u" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + L", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "r" }))

-- Resize the focused window (repeats while held): Super + Ctrl + H/J/K/L.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + H", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = -50, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + J", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = 50, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + K", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = -50, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + L", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 50, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true })

-- Toggle floating on the active window.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + SPACE", hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" }))

-- Center the active window (useful when floating).
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + C", hl.dsp.window.center())

--------------------------
---- KEYBINDINGS ---------
--------------------------

-- Session / window controls
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + RETURN", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(terminal)) -- open terminal
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + Q", hl.dsp.window.close()) -- close focused window
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + M", hl.dsp.exit()) -- quit Hyprland
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + L", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("hyprlock")) -- lock screen

-- Focus movement with arrow keys
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + LEFT", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "l" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + DOWN", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "d" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + UP", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "u" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + RIGHT", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "r" }))

-- Switch workspaces 1-9 with Super + [num];
-- move the focused window there with Super + Shift + [num].
for i = 1, 9 do
    hl.bind(mainMod .. " + " .. i, hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = i }))
    hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + " .. i, hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = i }))
end

-- Hardware keys: brightness / volume.
-- `repeating` = keep firing while held (old bindel),
-- `locked`    = works even while the screen is locked (old bindl).
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessDown", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set 10%-"), { repeating = true, locked = true })
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessUp", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set 10%+"), { repeating = true, locked = true })

-- Media player controls

hl.bind("XF86AudioNext", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("playerctl next"), { locked = true })
hl.bind("XF86AudioPrev", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("playerctl previous"), { locked = true })

-- Screenshots (grim + slurp):
--   Print            -> select region, copy image to clipboard
--   Super + Print    -> select region, save timestamped file to ~/Pictures
--   Super + Shift+Print -> full screen, copy image to clipboard

hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + PRINT", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("grim - | wl-copy"))

-- ============================================================

-- Super + D -> show desktop (toggle special workspace named "desktop")
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + D", hl.dsp.workspace.toggle_special("desktop"))

local home = os.getenv("HOME")
local mod = mainMod
local tui = terminal .. " -e "

local function toggle_named_workspace(name, command)
    return function()
        local current = hl.get_active_workspace()
        local target = hl.get_workspace(name)

        if current.name == name then
            local previous = hl.get_last_workspace()
            if previous then
                hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = previous.name }))
            end
            return
        end

        if command and (not target or target.is_empty) then
            hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd(command, { workspace = "name:" .. name }))
        end

        hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = "name:" .. name }))
    end
end

-- Session and window controls.
hl.bind(mod .. " + RETURN", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(terminal))
hl.bind(mod .. " + Q", hl.dsp.window.close())
hl.bind(mod .. " + M", hl.dsp.exit())
hl.bind(mod .. " + L", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("hyprlock"))
hl.bind(mod .. " + F", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "fullscreen", action = "toggle" }))
hl.bind(mod .. " + SHIFT + SPACE", hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" }))
hl.bind(mod .. " + SHIFT + C", hl.dsp.window.center())

-- Focus and move windows.
hl.bind(mod .. " + LEFT", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "l" }))
hl.bind(mod .. " + DOWN", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "d" }))
hl.bind(mod .. " + UP", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "u" }))

hl.bind(mod .. " + SHIFT + K", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "u" }))
hl.bind(mod .. " + SHIFT + L", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "r" }))

-- Continuous keyboard resizing.
local function resize(x, y)
    return function()
        hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = x, y = y, relative = true }))
    end
end

hl.bind(mod .. " + CTRL + H", resize(-50, 0), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mod .. " + CTRL + J", resize(0, 50), { repeating = true })

Yes. Your setup is already functional, but these additions would improve both daily usability and polish.

**Highest priority**

1. **Add `hypridle` for automatic locking**

You have `hyprlock`, but no idle daemon. Install/configure `hypridle` to:

- Lock after a few minutes.
- Turn the display off later.
- Suspend after a longer period.
- Lock immediately before suspend.

This is the biggest missing piece for a complete desktop setup.

2. **Start `swaync`**

It is already installed but not started in [autostart.lua](.config/hypr/autostart.lua). Add it to startup for:

- Notification history.
- Do-not-disturb mode.
- Volume, brightness, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth controls.
- A cleaner notification appearance.

3. **Add real window rules**

Create a separate `rules.lua` for applications such as:

- `pavucontrol`: floating and centered.
- `nm-connection-editor`: floating.
- `nwg-drawer`: floating with no border.
- Dialog windows: floating automatically.
- Development windows: assigned to the `debug` workspace.
- Browsers or communication apps: assigned to named workspaces.

Your modular structure makes this easy to maintain.

4. **Fix the Waybar toggle binding**

Currently this binding starts another Waybar process:

```lua
hl.bind(mod .. " + ALT + SPACE", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("waybar &"))
```

Repeatedly pressing it can create duplicate bars. Replace it with a toggle script that kills Waybar if running and starts it otherwise.

**Aesthetic improvements**

5. **Add deliberate active/inactive border colors**

Your current [looknfeel.lua](.config/hypr/looknfeel.lua) uses default border colors. A restrained palette would make focus much clearer:

- Mint or cyan for the active border.
- Muted gray for inactive windows.
- Keep the current 2px border.
- Avoid a large bright gradient because it can become visually noisy.

6. **Use subtle blur only if performance allows**

You currently have blur and shadows disabled. A small blur with low passes could make Waybar and drawers feel more integrated, but at 2880x1800 and 120 Hz, test carefully. Responsiveness matters more than decoration.

7. **Add workspace-specific rules**

For example:

- Workspace 1: browser.
- Workspace 2: editor.
- Workspace 3: terminal.
- Workspace 4: communication.
- Named workspaces: tmux, Neovim, top, debug.

This makes your workspace layout predictable after login.

**Useful quality-of-life additions**

8. **Clipboard history**

`cliphist` is not installed. Adding it would give you persistent clipboard history, usually bound to a launcher menu such as `Super + Ctrl + V`.

9. **Brightness and color temperature**

Consider `wlsunset` or another Wayland-compatible temperature tool for evening use. Your brightness keys already exist, so this would complete the display comfort setup.

10. **Add microphone status to Waybar**

You already have a microphone mute binding. Add microphone mute state to Waybar so you can see whether the input device is muted.

11. **Add a dedicated screenshot script**

Your current screenshot bindings work, but a script could provide:

- Region capture.
- Full-screen capture.
- Saved screenshots.
- Notifications after saving.
- Automatic directory creation.

12. **Review logging and cursor settings**

In [looknfeel.lua](.config/hypr/looknfeel.lua):

- `enable_stdout_logs = true` is useful for debugging but unnecessary during normal use.
- `no_hardware_cursors = true` can add overhead or slight latency. Keep it only if you actually need it to fix cursor glitches.

My recommended order is:

1. `hypridle`
2. Start `swaync`
3. Fix the Waybar toggle
4. Add window rules
5. Add active/inactive border colors
6. Add clipboard history
7. Add color-temperature scheduling

These changes would give you the biggest improvement without making the configuration unnecessarily complicated.

local function toggle_named_workspace(name, command)
    return function()
        local current = hl.get_active_workspace()
        local target = hl.get_workspace(name)

        if current.name == name then
            local previous = hl.get_last_workspace()
            if previous then
                hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = previous.name }))
            end
            return
        end

        if command and (not target or target.is_empty) then
            hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd(command, { workspace = "name:" .. name }))
        end

        hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = "name:" .. name }))
    end
end

#!/bin/sh

if pgrep -x waybar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pkill -x waybar
else
    nohup waybar -c "$HOME/.config/waybar/config.jsonc" -s "$HOME/.config/waybar/style.css" >/tmp/waybar.log 2>&1 &
fi

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

screenshot_dir="$HOME/Pictures/Screenshots"
mkdir -p "$screenshot_dir"

case "${1:-}" in
    copy)
        grim -g "$(slurp)" - | wl-copy
        notify-send "Screenshot copied" "Selected area is in the clipboard"
        ;;
    save)
        file="$screenshot_dir/Screenshot_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).png"
        grim -g "$(slurp)" "$file"
        notify-send "Screenshot saved" "$file"
        ;;
    full)
        grim - | wl-copy
        notify-send "Screenshot copied" "Full screen is in the clipboard"
        ;;
    *)
        printf '%s\n' "Usage: screenshot.sh {copy|save|full}" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

-- Requires Hyprland >= 0.55 (Lua config support).

--
-- API reference: https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/
-- LSP stubs for autocompletion: /usr/share/hypr/stubs/
-- ============================================================================

-----------------------
---- MY PROGRAMS ------
-----------------------

-- Your favorite programs, referenced by the keybinds below.
local terminal = "ghostty"

-- The main modifier key ("Windows" key). Used to build all Super combos.
local mainMod = "SUPER"

------------------------
---- MONITORS ----------
------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Monitors/

-- Catch-all: any unknown/unplugged monitor uses its preferred mode,
-- auto-positioned, scale 1.
hl.monitor({
    output = "",
    mode = "preferred",
    position = "auto",
    scale = 1,
})

-- Built-in laptop display: fixed 2880x1800 @ 120Hz, fractional scaling 1.5x.
hl.monitor({
    output = "eDP-1",
    mode = "2880x1800@120",
    position = "auto",
    scale = 1.5,
})

---------------------------
---- LOOK AND FEEL --------
---------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Variables/
hl.config({
    general = {
        gaps_in = 5, -- inner gaps between windows (px)
        gaps_out = 10, -- outer gaps around the screen edge (px)
        border_size = 2, -- window border thickness (px)

        layout = "dwindle", -- tiling layout engine
    },

    decoration = {
        rounding = 8, -- window corner rounding radius (px)
    },

    animations = {
        enabled = true,
    },
})

-- Custom bezier curve: fast start, smooth ease-out finish.
-- Points are control points of a cubic bezier: {x, y} pairs.
hl.curve("easeOut", {
    type = "bezier",
    points = { { 0.16, 1 }, { 0.3, 1 } },
})

-- Per-element animation settings.
-- speed is in "deciseconds per animation" style units (higher = slower),
-- bezier selects which curve to use ("default" = built-in curve).
hl.animation({ leaf = "windows", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- windows opening/moving
hl.animation({ leaf = "windowsOut", enabled = true, speed = 4, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- windows closing
hl.animation({ leaf = "border", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "default" }) -- border color changes
hl.animation({ leaf = "fade", enabled = true, speed = 4, bezier = "default" }) -- opacity fades
hl.animation({ leaf = "workspaces", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "easeOut" }) -- workspace switches

hl.config({
    cursor = {
        no_hardware_cursors = true, -- render cursors in software (fixes glitches on some GPUs)
    },

    misc = {
        disable_hyprland_logo = false, -- keep the Hyprland logo on startup
        disable_splash_rendering = false, -- keep the splash text on startup
    },

    debug = {
        disable_logs = false, -- keep writing logs to disk
        enable_stdout_logs = true, -- also mirror logs to stdout
    },
})

--------------------------
---- INPUT ---------------
--------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Variables/

hl.config({
    input = {
        kb_layout = "us", -- keyboard layout
        kb_options = "caps:swapescape", -- swap Caps Lock and Escape

        follow_mouse = 1, -- focus follows the mouse cursor
        scroll_factor = 1.0, -- wheel scroll speed multiplier
        sensitivity = 0.3, -- pointer sensitivity (-1.0 .. 1.0)
        natural_scroll = false,

        touchpad = {
            natural_scroll = true, -- invert scrolling direction on touchpad
            scroll_factor = 1.0,
        },
    },
})

--------------------------
---- AUTOSTART -----------
--------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Autostart/

-- Everything in this handler runs ONCE when Hyprland starts
-- (equivalent of exec-once; NOT re-run by hyprctl reload).
hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    hl.exec_cmd("hyprpaper") -- wallpaper daemon (see hyprpaper.conf)
    hl.exec_cmd("waybar") -- status bar
    hl.exec_cmd(os.getenv("HOME") .. "/.config/hypr/scripts/start-dock.sh") -- custom dock starter
    hl.exec_cmd("systemctl --user start hyprpolkitagent.service 2>/dev/null || true") -- polkit auth agent
    hl.exec_cmd("nm-applet --indicator") -- network manager tray icon
    hl.exec_cmd("blueman-applet") -- bluetooth tray icon
end)

-----------------------------
---- WINDOW MANAGEMENT ------
-----------------------------

-- Toggle real fullscreen with Super + F.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + F", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "fullscreen", action = "toggle" }))

-- Move the focused window around the layout: Super + Shift + H/J/K/L.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + H", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "l" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + J", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "d" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + K", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "u" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + L", hl.dsp.window.move({ direction = "r" }))

-- Resize the focused window (repeats while held): Super + Ctrl + H/J/K/L.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + H", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = -50, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + J", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = 50, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + K", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = -50, relative = true }), { repeating = true })
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + CTRL + L", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 50, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true })

-- Toggle floating on the active window.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + SPACE", hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" }))

-- Center the active window (useful when floating).
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + C", hl.dsp.window.center())

--------------------------
---- KEYBINDINGS ---------
--------------------------

-- Session / window controls
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + RETURN", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(terminal)) -- open terminal
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + Q", hl.dsp.window.close()) -- close focused window
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + M", hl.dsp.exit()) -- quit Hyprland
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + L", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("hyprlock")) -- lock screen

-- Focus movement with arrow keys
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + LEFT", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "l" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + DOWN", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "d" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + UP", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "u" }))
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + RIGHT", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "r" }))

-- Switch workspaces 1-9 with Super + [num];
-- move the focused window there with Super + Shift + [num].
for i = 1, 9 do
    hl.bind(mainMod .. " + " .. i, hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = i }))
    hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + " .. i, hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = i }))
end

-- Hardware keys: brightness / volume.
-- `repeating` = keep firing while held (old bindel),
-- `locked`    = works even while the screen is locked (old bindl).
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessDown", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set 10%-"), { repeating = true, locked = true })
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessUp", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set 10%+"), { repeating = true, locked = true })
hl.bind(
    "XF86AudioLowerVolume",
    hl.dsp.exec_cmd("wpctl set-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 5%-"),
    { repeating = true, locked = true }
)
hl.bind(
    "XF86AudioRaiseVolume",
    hl.dsp.exec_cmd("wpctl set-volume -l 1.0 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 5%+"),
    { repeating = true, locked = true }
)
hl.bind("XF86AudioMute", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle"), { locked = true })

-- Media player controls
hl.bind("XF86AudioPlay", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("playerctl play-pause"), { locked = true })
hl.bind("XF86AudioNext", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("playerctl next"), { locked = true })
hl.bind("XF86AudioPrev", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("playerctl previous"), { locked = true })

-- Screenshots (grim + slurp):
--   Print            -> select region, copy image to clipboard
--   Super + Print    -> select region, save timestamped file to ~/Pictures
--   Super + Shift+Print -> full screen, copy image to clipboard
hl.bind("PRINT", hl.dsp.exec_cmd('grim -g "$(slurp)" - | wl-copy'))
hl.bind(
    mainMod .. " + PRINT",
    hl.dsp.exec_cmd("grim -g \"$(slurp)\" ~/Pictures/Screenshot_$(date +'%Y%m%d_%H%M%S').png")
)
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + PRINT", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("grim - | wl-copy"))

-- ============================================================
-- APPLICATION / DESKTOP BINDINGS
-- ============================================================

-- Super + D -> show desktop (toggle special workspace named "desktop")
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + D", hl.dsp.workspace.toggle_special("desktop"))
-- Super + S -> launcher/drawer
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + S", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("nwg-drawer -wm hyprland"))
-- Super + E -> Nautilus file manager
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + E", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("nautilus"))
-- Super + C -> Chrome
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + C", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("google-chrome --new-window"))
-- Super + V -> VS Code
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + V", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("code"))
-- Super + Shift + A -> minimize current window
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + A", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(os.getenv("HOME") .. "/.config/hypr/scripts/minimize-window.sh"))
-- Super + Shift + B -> restore oldest minimized window
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SHIFT + B", hl.dsp.exec_cmd(os.getenv("HOME") .. "/.config/hypr/scripts/restore-window.sh"))

-- Tapping Super alone (on release) also opens the drawer.
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + SUPER_L", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("nwg-drawer -wm hyprland"), { release = true })

-- >>> jcode launch hotkeys (managed) >>>
-- jcode: home
hl.bind("SUPER + semicolon", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("/home/kairav/.jcode/hotkey/launch_jcode_0_cmd_semicolon.sh"))
-- jcode: last project
hl.bind("SUPER + apostrophe", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("/home/kairav/.jcode/hotkey/launch_jcode_1_cmd_quote.sh"))
-- jcode: self-dev

{"filePath":"/home/kairav/keys.md","content":"# Hyprland Keyboard Shortcuts

Modifier: `Super` is the Windows/Meta key.

## Session and Windows

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + Enter` | Open Ghostty terminal |
| `Super + Q` | Close the focused window |
| `Super + M` | Exit Hyprland |
| `Super + L` | Lock the screen with Hyprlock |
| `Super + F` | Toggle fullscreen |
| `Super + Shift + Space` | Toggle floating mode |
| `Super + Shift + C` | Center the focused window |
| `Alt + Tab` | Cycle to the next window |
| `Super + Super` | Open the application drawer when Super is released |

## Focus and Moving Windows

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + Left` | Focus the window to the left |
| `Super + Down` | Focus the window below |
| `Super + Up` | Focus the window above |
| `Super + Right` | Focus the window to the right |
| `Super + H` | Focus the previous workspace |
| `Super + L` | Focus the next workspace |
| `Super + Shift + H` | Move the focused window left |
| `Super + Shift + J` | Move the focused window down |
| `Super + Shift + K` | Move the focused window up |
| `Super + Shift + L` | Move the focused window right |
| `Super + mouse left-drag` | Move a floating window |
| `Super + mouse right-drag` | Resize a floating window |
| `Super + mouse wheel down` | Focus the next existing workspace |
| `Super + mouse wheel up` | Focus the previous existing workspace |

## Resizing

Hold the shortcut to resize continuously.

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + Ctrl + H` | Shrink horizontally from the right |
| `Super + Ctrl + J` | Grow vertically downward |
| `Super + Ctrl + K` | Shrink vertically upward |
| `Super + Ctrl + L` | Grow horizontally to the right |
| `Super + -` | Shrink horizontally |
| `Super + =` | Grow horizontally |
| `Super + Shift + -` | Shrink vertically |
| `Super + Shift + =` | Grow vertically |

## Numbered Workspaces

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + 1` through `Super + 9` | Switch to workspace 1 through 9 |
| `Super + 0` | Switch to workspace 10 |
| `Super + Shift + 1` through `Super + Shift + 9` | Move the focused window to workspace 1 through 9 |
| `Super + Shift + 0` | Move the focused window to workspace 10 |
| `Super + Tab` | Return to the last workspace |

## Named Workspaces

These shortcuts switch to a named workspace and launch its application if it is empty.
Press the same shortcut again to return to the previous workspace.

| Shortcut | Workspace | Application |
|---|---|---|
| `Super + Shift + Enter` | `tmux` | Ghostty running tmux |
| `Super + Shift + N` | `nvim` | Neovim in Ghostty |
| `Super + Shift + T` | `top` | btop in Ghostty |
| `Super + Shift + G` | `chrome` | Google Chrome |
| `Super + Shift + R` | `brave` | Brave Browser |

edits.text:
# Hyprland Keyboard Shortcuts

Modifier: `Super` is the Windows/Meta key.

## Session and Windows

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + Enter` | Open Ghostty terminal |
| `Super + Q` | Close the focused window |
| `Super + M` | Exit Hyprland |
| `Super + L` | Lock the screen with Hyprlock |
| `Super + F` | Toggle fullscreen |
| `Super + Shift + Space` | Toggle floating mode |
| `Super + Shift + C` | Center the focused window |
| `Alt + Tab` | Cycle to the next window |
| `Super + Super` | Open the application drawer when Super is released |

## Focus and Moving Windows

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + Left` | Focus the window to the left |
| `Super + Down` | Focus the window below |
| `Super + Up` | Focus the window above |
| `Super + Right` | Focus the window to the right |
| `Super + H` | Focus the previous workspace |
| `Super + L` | Focus the next workspace |
| `Super + Shift + H` | Move the focused window left |
| `Super + Shift + J` | Move the focused window down |
| `Super + Shift + K` | Move the focused window up |
| `Super + Shift + L` | Move the focused window right |
| `Super + mouse left-drag` | Move a floating window |
| `Super + mouse right-drag` | Resize a floating window |
| `Super + mouse wheel down` | Focus the next existing workspace |
| `Super + mouse wheel up` | Focus the previous existing workspace |

## Resizing

Hold the shortcut to resize continuously.

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + Ctrl + H` | Shrink horizontally from the right |
| `Super + Ctrl + J` | Grow vertically downward |
| `Super + Ctrl + K` | Shrink vertically upward |
| `Super + Ctrl + L` | Grow horizontally to the right |
| `Super + -` | Shrink horizontally |
| `Super + =` | Grow horizontally |
| `Super + Shift + -` | Shrink vertically |
| `Super + Shift + =` | Grow vertically |

## Numbered Workspaces

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + 1` through `Super + 9` | Switch to workspace 1 through 9 |
| `Super + 0` | Switch to workspace 10 |
| `Super + Shift + 1` through `Super + Shift + 9` | Move the focused window to workspace 1 through 9 |
| `Super + Shift + 0` | Move the focused window to workspace 10 |
| `Super + Tab` | Return to the last workspace |

## Named Workspaces

These shortcuts switch to a named workspace and launch its application if it is empty.
Press the same shortcut again to return to the previous workspace.

| Shortcut | Workspace | Application |
|---|---|---|
| `Super + Shift + Enter` | `tmux` | Ghostty running tmux |
| `Super + Shift + N` | `nvim` | Neovim in Ghostty |
| `Super + Shift + T` | `top` | btop in Ghostty |
| `Super + Shift + G` | `chrome` | Google Chrome |
| `Super + Shift + R` | `brave` | Brave Browser |
| `Super + Shift + D` | `debug` | Development/debug workspace |
| `Super + D` | `desktop` special workspace | Scratchpad-style desktop workspace |

## Applications and Utilities

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Super + S` | Open the application drawer |
| `Super + E` | Open Nautilus |
| `Super + C` | Open Google Chrome |
| `Super + V` | Open VS Code |
| `Super + Shift + A` | Minimize the focused window |
| `Super + Shift + B` | Restore the oldest minimized window |
| `Super + Alt + Space` | Toggle Waybar |
| `Super + Ctrl + V` | Open clipboard history and paste a selection |
| `Super + Ctrl + N` | Toggle the SwayNC notification center |
| `Super + ;` | Launch Jcode home |
| `Super + '` | Launch the last Jcode project |
| `Super + Shift + '` | Launch the Jcode self-development project |

## Screenshots

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Print` | Select an area and copy it to the clipboard |
| `Super + Print` | Select an area and save it to `~/Pictures/Screenshots` |
| `Super + Shift + Print` | Copy the full screen to the clipboard |

## Hardware and Media

These work while the screen is locked where supported.

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Brightness Down` | Decrease brightness by 10% |
| `Brightness Up` | Increase brightness by 10% |
| `Volume Down` | Decrease volume by 5% |
| `Volume Up` | Increase volume by 5% |
| `Mute` | Toggle speaker mute |
| `Microphone Mute` | Toggle microphone mute |
| `Play/Pause` | Toggle media playback |
| `Next Track` | Next media track |
| `Previous Track` | Previous media track |

## Touchpad Gesture

- Three-finger horizontal swipe: switch workspaces.
